# Product Brief

## Product Summary

beta-integration demonstrates local event ingestion and durable processing.

## Problem

A single operator cannot reliably observe long-running work after leaving the active application.

## Primary User and Context

The primary user is one local operator working from a Windows workstation and checking outcomes remotely.

## Intended Outcome

The operator receives a deterministic status result without forwarding private content.

## MVP Scope

The MVP covers one local installation, one event source, durable state, and automated verification.

## Boundaries

The fixture excludes multi-user administration, hosted services, and unrelated product expansion.

## Assumptions

The local machine and configured external endpoint are available during the demonstration.
